name: agentmug-core
description: Apache-2.0 portable-agent specification, runtime, CLI, bridges, integrations, and examples.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && npm --prefix integrations/n8n-nodes-agentmug run build
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @agentmug/runtime run build && pnpm --filter @agentmug/cli run build && pnpm --filter @agentmug/mcp-bridge run build && pnpm --filter @agentmug/otel run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @agentmug/runtime run typecheck && pnpm --filter @agentmug/cli run typecheck && pnpm --filter @agentmug/mcp-bridge run typecheck && pnpm --filter @agentmug/otel run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @agentmug/runtime run test:artifact-contract && pnpm --filter @agentmug/runtime run test:capability-execute && pnpm --filter @agentmug/runtime run test:architectures && pnpm --filter @agentmug/runtime run test:source-contract && pnpm --filter @agentmug/runtime run test:engine-sources && pnpm --filter @agentmug/runtime run test:evaluations && pnpm --filter @agentmug/runtime run test:net-guard && pnpm --filter @agentmug/runtime run test:llm-routing && pnpm --filter @agentmug/runtime run test:actions && pnpm --filter @agentmug/runtime run test:schema-drift && pnpm --filter @agentmug/runtime run test:deployment-contract && pnpm --filter @agentmug/cli run test && pnpm --filter @agentmug/mcp-bridge run test && npm --prefix integrations/n8n-nodes-agentmug test && pnpm run test:release-state
scripts.security:audit: pnpm audit --prod --audit-level moderate && npm --prefix integrations/n8n-nodes-agentmug audit --omit=dev --audit-level moderate && npm --prefix integrations/n8n-nodes-agentmug run test:upstream-dev-tooling-risk && npm --prefix integrations/n8n-nodes-agentmug run test:dependency-security
scripts.security:licenses: node scripts/check-public-package-licenses.mjs && node scripts/check-production-licenses.mjs --scope public --repository dahshanlabs/agentmug-core
scripts.verify: pnpm run lint && pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run security:audit && pnpm run security:licenses && pnpm run security:tree && pnpm run pack:verify
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && pnpm install --lockfile-only --ignore-scripts --no-frozen-lockfile && node scripts/audit-public-core.mjs --root . --public-repository dahshanlabs/agentmug-core --write-manifest
